say:2:1610365001:1.text: I was worried about you, Gervan... I didn't expect you to catch up so quickly.
say:2:1610365001:1.source_cn: 格墨文，我正在担心你呢……没想到你这么快就赶上来了。

say:3:1610365002:1.text: I said I'd be fine. See? I've already got the key from the other side of the island.
say:3:1610365002:1.source_cn: 我说了没问题的。瞧，我已经在岛的另外一边拿到一把钥匙了。

choice_prompt:4:1610365002.text: I said I'd be fine. See? I've already got the key from the other side of the island.
choice_prompt:4:1610365002.source_cn: 我说了没问题的。瞧，我已经在岛的另外一边拿到一把钥匙了。

say:5:1610365003:1.text: As expected of you, Gervan. Why don't you head back first?
say:5:1610365003:1.source_cn: 不愧是你啊，格墨文。怎么样，你要先回去吗？

say:6:1610365004:1.text: No, we arrived as a party, and we'll leave as one. I'll explore the area with you two.
say:6:1610365004:1.source_cn: 不，我们一起来的，当然也要一起回去。剩下的地方我和你们...
say:6:1610365004:1.male: No, we arrived as a party, and we'll leave as one. I'll explore the area with you two.
say:6:1610365004:1.female: No, we arrived as a party, and we'll leave as one. I'll explore the area with you two.

say:7:1610365005:1.text: I insist on continuing with you both.
say:7:1610365005:1.source_cn: 我知道你们会劝我先返回，不过我坚持如此。
say:7:1610365005:1.male: I insist on continuing with you both.
say:7:1610365005:1.female: I insist on continuing with you both.

say:8:1610365006:1.text: Alright, the door is open. Let's go in together.
say:8:1610365006:1.source_cn: 门已经打开了，我们一起进去吧！

choice:4:1:2.text: You can go back and try the mechanism.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 既然如此，你先回去启动机关？
choice:4:1:2.male: You can go back and try the mechanism.
choice:4:1:2.female: You can go back and try the mechanism.
